summary: The 'Unclaimed Evidence Register' exists in Paper/evidence-map.md (heading at line 53, intro lines 55-60, table lines 62-68). It is titled 'Unclaimed Evidence Register' with the gloss 'Retained runs that exist but no theme THEORY.md currently builds theory on. Inventory is not ownership... each row names a candidate owning theme.' The table header is '| Run family | What it holds | Candidate owning theme |'. Current rows verbatim: (1) `p9c-*` (compiler-ecology, I13-I17) | prose vs mechanized coordination organs in a persistent multi-agent workspace | `social-behavior` <-> `open-ended-ecology` boundary (Mechanization Ceiling). (2) `p11-digital-redqueen` (`matches.jsonl`) | adversarial co-evolution on OS routing surfaces; symmetry trap | **ownership decision needed** - neither `viability-habitat` nor `autopoiesis-renewal` will take it; candidate new adversarial-selection owner. (3) `p12-dormancy-ecology/12.05-*` (body-chain) | inheritance-bottleneck carrier selection across generations | `open-ended-ecology` (Compression-Carrier Selection). (4) `p7e/g/i/r/s/w`, 50+ raw ecology tapes | proto-ecology, trace causality, niche repair | `open-ended-ecology`. (5) `p6r-*` (deterministic systems controls) | ARR false-positive controls, audit/admission | `autopoiesis-renewal`. NOTE: the register's 'candidate owning theme' column names retired THEME labels (social-behavior, open-ended-ecology, viability-habitat, autopoiesis-renewal), not the new flat theory objects; the restructure-design Phase 0/Phase 5 task (lines 370-372, 508-509) requires these 5 families to be routed into theory-object ## Evidence sections before evidence-map.md is demoted. Several routings are already partially in place: trace-inheritance.md, affordance-null-ecology.md, stigmergy-as-carrier.md cite the p7 families; narrative-claim.md and viability-pressure.md already reference P11; the carrier-selection gap already lists 'P12.05; P9c' as candidate evidence (gaps/carrier-selection.md lines 47, 51); and 6R controls are cited in carrier.md, exec-barrier.md, delayed-addressability.md, future-task-surface.md, narrative-claim.md.

entries.note: The register's old theme label is the 'social-behavior <-> open-ended-ecology' boundary (Mechanization Ceiling). In the flat theory layer the social-behavior side is owned by protocol-emergence (invented routing/callback over thin surfaces) and coordination-closure (joint completion via visible state intersection). protocol-emergence.md ALREADY names p9c twice (lines 50, 67) as candidate evidence for callback-necessity ('the L5 peer-callback fixture ... and experiments/p9c-compiler-ecology'), so the cleanest close is to lift those candidate-evidence mentions into protocol-emergence's ## Evidence section, and add a coordination-closure ## Evidence row for the prose-vs-mechanized coordination-organ finding. The 'Mechanization Ceiling' (prose organ vs mechanized organ) is the protocol-emergence/coordination-closure tension, not an ecology claim. The restructure-design maps the p9c artifact to the 'benchmarks' navigation family (infrastructure-shaped, no theory objects), but the SCIENTIFIC ownership of the coordination finding routes to protocol-emergence/coordination-closure — family != theory object (P2). Secondary: trace-inheritance.md and carrier-selection.md already touch p9c as candidate evidence for callback-necessity / carrier selection; those are weaker and need not be promoted on close.

Per-variant routing: p7e (open/null ecology, 7.9-7.13 neighbors) -> affordance-null-ecology + structural-pull (null-ecology family); p7g (generation ecology, cross-generation niche repair) -> trace-inheritance + stigmergy-as-carrier (trace-inheritance family) — p7g is already cited as the P7G/P7T trace-causality backbone in trace-inheritance.md and stigmergy-as-carrier.md, and as a paper reference (agentic-alife-workshop/references/p7g-trace-uptake-evidence.md); p7i (irregularity ecology) -> trace-inheritance (merged into trace-inheritance family per restructure-design Decision 1); p7s (seeded-workspace ecology) -> trace-inheritance / stigmergy-as-carrier; p7w (wiki-frontier / cumulative-novelty) -> affordance-null-ecology (primary per restructure family table) and structural-pull (frontier expansion); p7r (role ecology — spontaneous labor division, missionless role differentiation) -> coordination-closure + protocol-emergence (social-role family per restructure-design Appendix A line 256). affordance-null-ecology.md ## Evidence currently cites only generic 'P7 missionless runs (experiments/p7-oee/)' and trace-inheritance.md cites the 'P7G/P7T backbone' — neither cites the specific p7e/p7i/p7r/p7s/p7w variant tapes by ID, so closing this row is the heaviest of the five (route each variant's representative tapes to its object's ## Evidence). entries.source: p6r controls (experiments/p6r-agentic-runtime-replacement/, 6R.01-6R.04: subprocess-vs-exec boundary, scripted-reexec baseline, audit-trace-package, admission-and-carrier-transfer; register row 'deterministic systems controls — ARR false-positive controls, audit/admission')
entries.note: Register theme is 'autopoiesis-renewal' — ARR (agentic-runtime-replacement) false-positive controls, audit/admission. In the flat theory layer the controls are the discriminating discipline on the carrier/successor spine and are ALREADY cited in prose across the load-bearing continuity objects. Specifically: narrative-claim.md (line 54) names '6R.01-6R.04, the ARR false-positive controls that reject subprocess, parent-forwarding, external re-exec, and launch-only' as the carrier-side discriminating discipline; carrier.md's Appendix-G ## Code sample cites '6R.01-6R.04 rule out false-positive transfer paths'; exec-barrier owns the subprocess-vs-exec boundary (6R.01) and the hard-barrier primitive these controls protect; delayed-addressability owns the individuality criterion these controls keep honest (rejecting narrated/launch-only succession as a positive). Primary routing target is exec-barrier (the 6R.01 subprocess-vs-exec-boundary and 6R.02 scripted-reexec baseline are exec-barrier controls) and carrier (6R.04 admission-and-carrier-transfer); secondary delayed-addressability and narrative-claim (false-positive rejection). Closing the row means adding ## Evidence entries citing 6R.01-6R.04 by ID on exec-barrier/carrier (they currently live only in prose / the ## Code sample / paper dossiers, not in those objects' ## Evidence lists). This is the family with the highest existing cross-object prose coverage, so it is the lightest of the five to close.
